info.title: SkyblockGPT Unified Data Gateway
info.description: One compact gateway for Hypixel SkyBlock profiles, inventories, sack counts, resources, Bazaar, auctions, lowest BIN scans, feeds, guilds, network players, and player extras.

get.summary: List a player's compact SkyBlock profiles
get.description: Lists profile IDs, cute names, selected state, last save, game mode, and SkyBlock level without returning the full profile payload.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID returned by the username lookup action.

get.summary: Get a compact SkyBlock profile summary
get.description: Returns profile identity, SkyBlock level, currencies, fairy souls, calculated skill levels, Slayer data, and a compact Dungeons summary.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID returned by the username lookup action.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile ID or cute name. Omit it to use the selected or most recently saved profile.

get.summary: Get one compact SkyBlock profile section
get.description: Returns one compact profile section: skills, slayers, dungeons, mining/HotM, forge, foraging/HotF, stats counters, gear, pets, accessories, bestiary summary, potion effects/buffs, rift, crimson isle/Kuudra, farming/Jacob contests, minions, trophy fish, chocolate factory, or hunting shards.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID returned by the username lookup action.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile ID or cute name. Omit it to use the selected or most recently saved profile.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: The profile-data section needed for the current question.

get.summary: Read typed player collection progress
get.description: Returns paginated player collection amounts with official achieved tiers, next-tier requirements, and optional unlocked reward text.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID returned by the username lookup action.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile ID or cute name. Omit it to use the selected or most recently saved profile.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional collection ID, display name, or category search.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Collection entries per response.

parameters.name: include_unlocks
parameters.description: Include official reward text for every achieved tier and the next tier. Use only when recipes or unlocks matter.

get.summary: Get typed, computed SkyBlock Bestiary progress
get.description: Returns computed Bestiary progress: overall milestone and Bestiary level (milestone/10) plus a pageable, name-searchable per-family list with kills, tier, and next-tier kills. Families missing from the bracket table report tier null, never a guess.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID returned by the username lookup action.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile ID or cute name. Omit it to use the selected or most recently saved profile.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive text matched against family ID, family name, and island/category name.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Collection entries per response.

get.summary: Read typed Accessory Bag contents
get.description: Decodes and paginates the Accessory Bag with item IDs, names, slots, reforges, upgrades, unique counts, and exact duplicate IDs.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID returned by the username lookup action.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile ID or cute name. Omit it to use the selected or most recently saved profile.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional exact or partial accessory item ID or display-name search.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Accessories per response.

get.summary: List every available compressed item container
get.description: Discovers NBT item containers (including rift_* Rift inventories) and reports wardrobe/loadout metadata and whether numeric sack contents are available without returning oversized inventory data.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile ID or cute name.

get.summary: Read one paginated item container
get.description: Decodes one container returned by the inventory index. Summary supports up to 50 items per page; full data is capped at 5 items per page.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile ID or cute name.

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: Exact container ID returned by getCompactSkyBlockInventoryIndex.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based results page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Requested items per page. Full detail is capped at 5.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Use summary for lists or full for lore, ExtraAttributes, and parsed NBT.

get.summary: Read full parsed data for one item slot
get.description: Returns one item's name, ID, lore, enchantments, attributes, ExtraAttributes, and parsed NBT from a discovered container and slot. Nested backpack or cake-bag byte data is decoded into contained_items.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile ID or cute name.

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: Exact container ID returned by getCompactSkyBlockInventoryIndex.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: Exact item slot returned by the container endpoint.

get.summary: Read item quantities stored in sacks
get.description: Returns the selected member's positive sacks_counts entries with official item names, search, sorting, and pagination. This reads quantities, not merely owned Sack items.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile ID or cute name.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional item ID or name search within sack contents.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Sack item counts per response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field used to sort matching sack entries.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Ascending or descending sort direction.

get.summary: Read Museum, Garden, or Bingo data
get.description: Returns a response-size-safe Museum inventory, Garden state, or player Bingo history. Museum entries are searchable, paginated, and flag borrowed donations; detail=full expands decoded Museum items.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional profile ID or cute name for Museum or Garden.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The player-specific dataset to retrieve.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional Museum item search text.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based Museum result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Museum entries per page.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Museum only: full expands each entry's decoded items but caps the page at 5 entries and 4 items per entry.

get.summary: Search official SkyBlock resources
get.description: Searches and pages Collections, Skills, Items, Election candidates (with the current mayor), or Bingo goals. query, page, and limit apply to every kind; detail=full caps limit at 10.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The official Hypixel resource dataset.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional ID, key, or name search over items, collections, skills, election candidates, or bingo goals.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page; detail=full caps this at 10.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Summary for lists or full for every available resource field.

get.summary: Read SkyBlock news or Fire Sales
get.description: Searches and pages official SkyBlock news or active and upcoming Fire Sales. Fire Sale rows carry item_id plus a joined display item_name; responses include source_last_updated and a truncated flag.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The live feed to retrieve.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional search over news title, text, and link, or Fire Sale item_id and item_name.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page.

get.summary: Search and rank all Bazaar products
get.description: Searches the complete current Hypixel Bazaar snapshot and returns compact prices, volumes, weekly movement, orders, spreads, and pagination.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional product ID or display-name search.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field used to rank matching products.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction.

get.summary: Read one full Bazaar product
get.description: Returns all current Hypixel data for one Bazaar product: both order summaries, quick status, volumes, prices, orders, and spread. An ambiguous display name returns HTTP 400 with up to 12 candidate product_id and display_name suggestions.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Exact Bazaar product ID, or an official display name matching exactly one product. Prefer the exact ID from the product-search operation.

get.summary: Browse one current Auction House page
get.description: Filters and sorts one official active-auction page. Its page-scoped lowest BIN is not global; use the direct SkyCofl Action for normal LBin checks.

parameters.name: upstream_page
parameters.description: Zero-based official Hypixel auction page.

parameters.name: result_page
parameters.description: Zero-based page within matches from that official page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Matching auctions per response; full detail is capped at five.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional item name, extra text, or auction UUID search within this official page.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional exact auction category filter.

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: Optional exact rarity or tier filter.

parameters.name: bin
parameters.description: Optional BIN-only or auction-only filter.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Keep source order, sort by ending time, or sort price ascending or descending. Omitted default is source order, or price ascending when bin=true.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Summary for browsing or full for lore, bids, and decoded item NBT.

get.summary: Find the lowest BIN for an exact item
get.description: Resource-safe fallback that scans up to 4 official AH pages and verifies exact item IDs from NBT. Prefer the direct SkyCofl lowest-BIN operation for normal price checks.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Exact official SkyBlock item ID or exact official item name.

parameters.name: start_page
parameters.description: First official AH page to scan; begin with zero and continue from next_start_page only when required.

parameters.name: max_pages
parameters.description: Maximum official AH pages scanned in this Action call.

parameters.name: expected_last_updated
parameters.description: For continuation calls, pass the first segment's snapshot_last_updated value to reject mixed AH snapshots.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Cheapest verified matching BIN auctions returned per scan segment.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional exact Auction House category filter.

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: Optional exact rarity or tier filter.

get.summary: Look up auctions by auction, player, or profile
get.description: Looks up official auctions using exactly one auction UUID, player UUID, or profile UUID. uuid lookups default to detail=full with limit=1; player and profile lookups default to summary with 20 per page. Full detail caps limit at 5. Responses include source_last_updated.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Exact auction UUID. Do not combine with player or profile.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player UUID. Do not combine with uuid or profile.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: SkyBlock profile UUID. Do not combine with uuid or player.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page; full detail is capped at five. Defaults to 1 for uuid lookups and 20 for player or profile lookups.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Summary or full auction data with decoded NBT. Defaults to full for uuid lookups and summary for player or profile lookups.

get.summary: Read recently ended auctions
get.description: Returns compact, paginated auctions from Hypixel's recent-ended window. Summary rows decode just item_id and item_name with a per-row decode_status under a per-call decode budget; detail=full returns complete decoded item NBT.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional auction, seller, or buyer UUID search.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based result page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page; full detail is capped at five.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Summary or full data with decoded sold-item NBT.

get.summary: Read a compact Hypixel guild
get.description: Looks up a Hypixel guild by exactly one of player (UUID), name, or id. Returns compact identity, tag, created, exp, level computed from the guild EXP curve, SkyBlock guild exp, the queried player membership, and paginated members. No guild means data_present=false with guild null, not an error.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: A member's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID. Provide exactly one of player, name, or id.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Exact guild name. Provide exactly one of player, name, or id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 24-character hexadecimal Hypixel guild ID. Provide exactly one of player, name, or id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based member-list page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Guild members per response.

get.summary: Read Hypixel network player, status, or counts
get.description: kind=player picks network identity: displayname, normalized rank, social links, logins, and skyblock_* achievement skill levels (the skill fallback when the profile API is off). kind=status returns only a visible session; hidden is unavailable, never confirmed offline. kind=counts: SKYBLOCK counts.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The network dataset to retrieve.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The player's dashed or undashed Minecraft UUID. Required for kind=player and kind=status; ignored for kind=counts.

ProxyApiKey.name: X-GPT-Key
ProxyApiKey.description: A private shared secret configured in both the Worker and the Custom GPT Action settings. This is not the Hypixel API key.

attribute_levels.description: Attribute name to level map, parallel to attributes.

enchantment_levels.description: Enchantment name to level map, parallel to enchantments.

computed_magical_power.description: Proxy-computed Magical Power using SkyCrypt rules: only the highest tier per accessory upgrade family counts, recombobulation bumps rarity, Hegemony Artifact counts double, plus Abicase and consumed Rift Prism bonuses. Null when the bag or item catalog is unavailable.

unknown_tier_ids.description: Accessory IDs whose tier was not in the item catalog; they contributed 0 MP.

truncated.description: True when order summaries or quick status were cut by response size limits.
True when some record content was cut by response size limits.

mayor.description: kind=election only: the sitting mayor; null when Hypixel did not expose one.

current_election_year.description: kind=election only: year of the running election, or null between elections.

bingo_id.description: kind=bingo only: the current bingo event ID.

BestiaryFamilyProgress.description: Computed Bestiary progress for one mob family (or one raw untracked kill counter when in_bracket_table is false).

tier.description: Computed Bestiary tier. Null when the family is missing from the transcribed bracket table; never guessed.

weekly_exp.description: Sum of the member's rolling 7-day expHistory; null when Hypixel exposed none.

level.description: Computed from exp via the SkyCrypt-transcribed guild EXP curve; null when exp is unavailable.

skyblock_guild_exp.description: guildExpByGameType.SKYBLOCK; null when Hypixel exposed none.

queried_player.description: The queried player's own membership when the player parameter was used; null otherwise.
